blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Nest retains issuer / admin authority over vault shares with permissioned issuance and freeze surfaces beyond reserve-only exposure.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: nOPAL has three reviewed independent native-issuance routes on Ethereum, Plume, and BSC. Nest's current registry and fixed-block supply reads establish three live native liability surfaces; the Plume and BSC rows retain Ethereum as the issuer's primary reference but are canonical native issuance, not peripheral bridge representations. Nest's current registry and nOPAL integration guide also identify a Solana LayerZero OFT route via OFT store FmeHf1FQJhXUWHVfLACCHJ8KvAJ7jpiDvukz8ZHP7XLq; its Solana mint and route are authored below. Additional Plasma, World Chain, and Avalanche deployments are not authored because their route mechanics remain unsourced.

routes.reviewNote: Independent native nOPAL issuance on Ethereum, not a bridge representation. The current 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 owns the Teller and Manager and is the Timelock proposer/canceller; no public bridge route was identified.
